notes: UOC-000 classifies capability exposure; it does not add runtime execution.
Current UI mapping is read-only unless an existing API contract explicitly declares a governed local-state mutation.
UOC-002 extends the existing read-only workspace surface with typed document inspection; it does not expose shell or mutation.
UOC-000 freezes architecture and classification only; no runtime route or executor is added.
A capability classified as CLI-BRIDGE-REGISTERED is not authorized for UI subprocess execution.
Future sprints must update this registry atomically with API/UI route contracts and Test Impact evidence.
UOC-003 changes six deterministic validation/checklist capabilities to UI-READ-ONLY through one typed facade; remaining UOC-003-tagged CLI bridges stay inventoried.
UOC-004 UI-native plan capability is metadata on ui.workspace-documents; CLI command inventory remains truthful and unchanged until UOC-007 parity work.
UOC-004 remains non-mutating. UOC-005 is the first narrow source-write exception: Markdown/JSON/YAML document apply/rollback bound to exact approval, plan hash, base hash, scope, actor and TTL.
Generic patch.apply, generic rollback, arbitrary shell, Git write, remote execution, connector write and plugin execution remain policy-blocked.
